result:
I’d make the circumstances of your birth matter far less.

Where you’re born, how much money your parents have, whether your body fits what society expects—those things shouldn’t decide whether you get safety, an education, or room to become yourself.

Not a world where everyone ends up the same. A world where fewer lives are narrowed before they’ve really begun.
